answer: Time-locked reputation escrow: a new agent's earnings flow through an inlet into escrow that unlocks only after a 30-epoch horizon of honest work. Step 1: each identity bonds 50 POA. Step 2: auditors spot-check 5% of its tasks; one fraudulent result slashes the bond and all escrow. Step 3: voting weight grows linearly and reaches its zenith only at epoch 30, never bought or transferred. A clone farm must lock 50 POA per fake and wait the same ~7.5 days, since elapsed time can't be parallelized, so 1,000 fakes freeze 50,000 POA while earning almost nothing.
